_inherited_budget_note: The 2026/27 budget was set by the outgoing No-Overall-Control administration (4 Mar 2026). Reform UK won 7 May 2026 (Reform's FIRST London borough) and formed the Cabinet at Annual Council 28 May 2026, inheriting the budget; the first Reform-set budget will be 2027/28.
_critical_distress_flag: Havering is structurally insolvent without government bailout: 3rd consecutive Exceptional Financial Support / Capitalisation Direction (~GBP 70-77m for 2026/27, ~GBP 200m+ cumulative borrowing) with a LIVE S114 trigger (the S151 must issue a S114 if the Capitalisation Direction is not awarded to value). EFS forecast through 2028/29.

administration.note: Reform UK won the 7 May 2026 all-out election (39 of 55, up from 3), taking Reform's FIRST London borough from No Overall Control. Leader Cllr Keith Prince (also London Assembly Member for Havering and Redbridge, former Leader of Redbridge). Opposition: Residents' Associations (14 combined) + Labour 2. Part of Greater London (GLA precept; North East London ICB).
